I deliberately excluded high-raise names with negative price momentum or pending binary events I cannot underwrite (MU, INTC, GEV, VRT, ALB). I would be wrong if the Oct-Nov earnings cluster shows the raises were lagging rather than leading indicators, or if a single AI-capex digestion headline hits the correlated software/semis sleeve at once.
